-- In a real estate market where speed often dominates the conversation, Scottsdale real estate agent Michael Kitlas has built his business around something more durable: trust. As the founder of the Michael Kitlas Group at My Home Group Real Estate, Michael Kitlas focuses on helping buyers and sellers across Arizona’s East Valley and West Valley make confident real estate decisions backed by strategy and clear guidance.
Born and raised in Arizona, Michael Kitlas understands the local market from the inside. As a Scottsdale real estate agent working throughout both the East Valley and West Valley, his work spans residential homes, land opportunities, investment properties, and commercial transactions. Michael Kitlas is also part of the WeSERV association, the West and Southeast REALTORS of the Valley, further strengthening his presence across multiple Arizona markets.
His approach is simple but intentional. Rather than treating real estate like a volume-driven business, Michael Kitlas focuses on serving families, building long-term relationships, and helping clients make decisions that support both financial growth and lifestyle goals.
Michael Kitlas has long believed that success is not measured by the number of transactions completed each year, but by the number of families he has the opportunity to serve. His true measure of success is the positive impact he makes, helping clients achieve their financial goals and move forward with confidence through every stage of their real estate journey. This philosophy remains central to the Michael Kitlas Group and continues to shape how the team approaches every listing and purchase.
For sellers looking to sell a home in Phoenix or surrounding East Valley or West Valley communities, one of the first challenges is often pricing strategy. Many homeowners either overprice their property and sit on the market or underprice and leave equity on the table.
The Michael Kitlas Group focuses on detailed comparable analysis, strategic market positioning, and timing strategies designed to maximize property exposure and sale value.
Instead of simply placing listings on the MLS and waiting for activity, the team emphasizes presentation, targeted marketing, and buyer-focused positioning to help homes compete more effectively in the marketplace. High-quality photography, compelling marketing videos, and strategic online exposure are designed to generate demand rather than simply capture existing interest.
In Arizona’s competitive real estate markets, that level of presentation can make the difference between an average outcome and an exceptional result.
For buyers, success in today’s market often depends on preparation, timing, and strategy. Across Scottsdale, Gilbert, Chandler, Mesa, Queen Creek, and surrounding communities, competition can be intense for both resale and new construction homes. Michael Kitlas helps buyers stay ahead of the market by identifying opportunities early, developing competitive offer strategies, and positioning clients to make confident decisions in highly competitive situations.
Communication also remains a core part of the Michael Kitlas Group experience. One of the most common frustrations clients experience when working with agents is a lack of clarity during important stages of the transaction. Michael Kitlas has built a communication structure designed to keep clients informed from the initial consultation through closing so buyers and sellers always understand what stage they are in, what steps come next, and how decisions may impact the outcome of their transaction.
The business model itself is built around long-term relationships rather than short-term transactions. Many clients return to the Michael Kitlas Group years later when they are ready to upgrade homes, explore investment properties across Arizona, or transition into luxury homes in areas such as Scottsdale or Paradise Valley. Others refer friends and family members, turning satisfied clients into long-term advocates for the brand.
That philosophy is shaped in part by Michael Kitlas’s own journey. At eighteen, he signed a record deal and spent several years touring nationally and internationally with his band, fulfilling a lifelong dream. While that experience provided unforgettable opportunities, it also reinforced the importance of hard work, adaptability, and perseverance. After transitioning into more traditional career paths, Michael discovered real estate as a way to combine his entrepreneurial mindset with a genuine passion for helping others build wealth, achieve their goals, and create a stronger financial future.
Today, Michael Kitlas is recognized among Arizona’s top-performing real estate professionals. He has consistently ranked in the top percentile of agents in both Maricopa and Pinal Counties for multiple years. His performance has earned him numerous industry accolades, including the 40 Under 40 Award from the West and Southeast REALTORS of the Valley. Michael also maintains a strong record of five star client reviews on his Google Business Profile, reflecting a consistent commitment to service and results.
Beyond awards, Michael Kitlas defines success in a simple way: every transaction is treated as the beginning of a long-term relationship. Whether a client is buying a first home in Chandler, exploring investment properties in Phoenix, searching for land across Arizona, or selling a home in Scottsdale, the focus remains the same: providing trusted guidance, clear strategy, and a client-first process.
Through this approach, Michael Kitlas has become a trusted presence across Arizona, serving clients throughout the East Valley and West Valley markets. Michael Kitlas helps buyers and sellers navigate one of life’s most important financial decisions with confidence, clarity, and expert guidance.
